system.description:
Stretching your physical form across the Shroud, you touch and grapple the entities and scenery of the Underworld even as your body remains rooted in the living world.

Expend a Willpower Trait to touch the contents of the Shadowlands for a scene or an hour, whichever comes first; each additional scene or hour costs one Blood Trait to maintain. You do not pierce the Shroud, but your actions affect both worlds: you can climb a ghostly rope and step onto a real roof, or strike and grapple wraiths (though they may strike back). You cannot push or pull objects from one world into the other.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.bloodCost: 1 Willpower Trait, then 1 Blood Trait per scene
